g.title: cluster_graph
g.text: nodes are S lines and arrows are links (L lines)
s5 is an HG002 allele in place of s3

g.title: cluster_files
g.text: each node and each link has a row filed under a chr1 interval

g.title: cluster_query
g.text: one tabix request per file returns the rows filed over chr1:25-30

g.title: cluster_drawn
g.text: the dashed nodes come from the link rows alone

g.title: rows
g.text: s5 lies off chr1, so the tool files it under the reference span
it hangs from: s2 to s4, chr1:10-40.
The tool files a link under the span both its nodes reach, so a
query near either node returns it. The row gives both nodes'
coordinates, so a reader places the far node without another query.

g.title: hits
g.text: The reader keeps a link when the node file returned one of its nodes, or when both its nodes
are far ends of links it kept. s1→s2 fails both tests, since no kept link ends at s1.
